releaseNotes:
NextGenSoftware.OASIS.Providers.Shared.KeyValueStorage v2.0.1

Complete OASIS storage provider implementation (avatars, avatar details, holons, parent/child links, search, import/export) over any key-value or blob service. Used by the edge KV and blob storage providers. https://oasisomniverse.one

What's new since v1.0.0
- Add bounded physical-source audit for V2 lineage migration (216a0ca)
- Add bounded Self Protocol registry CQL to sandbox candidate (35707d1)
- Add current Civic public network CQL to scoped sandbox candidate (ef62c32)
- Add operation-scoped native fee and rebate accounting (e8ec723)
- Add TRON CQL adapter and share bounded identity query compilation with S3 (1eeb26a)
- Adopt matching SQLite replica lineage atomically with migration receipt (cd712bc)
- Apply shared metadata filtering to Mongo avatar and holon search results (dd501b7)
- Bind avatar identity indexes to current record owner before reads and deletes (c5ed615)
- Bind complete frozen source and historical receiver proofs into migration reviews (f18d187)
- Bind explicit migration evidence consistency to preparation approval (e4e2172)
- Bind historical receiver receipts and consistency into migration reviews (87a26e6)
- Bind migration mutation preparation to reviewed evidence and policy identity (d4ad017)
- Bind Mongo replica transactions to native collection UUID and preserve captured acknowledgement (6075d26)
- Bind primary replication enrollment and recovery to native source storage identity (6683642)
- Bind SQLite replica admission to native store transaction and catalog identity (49a5603)
- Bind Sui physical storage writes to admitted preparation ownership (f81cde6)
- Bound native storage correlations and document approved operation fee policy (2acf0a8)
- Build immutable lineage migration reviews from complete bounded native evidence (7460037)
- Carry admitted cancellation through TRON Sui and Cosmos SDK boundaries (f2af1d9)
- Classify invalid shared search requests before storage access (34209c4)
- Classify malformed authenticated private storage envelopes as corruption (2a79cf4)
- Classify malformed chain storage responses as terminal data failures (3bd4342)
- Classify persisted cloud JSON corruption at shared storage boundary (388ccb4)
- Classify shared search ancestry corruption as terminal data failure (27e3f32)
- Compare verified source receipts with bound replica heads before migration (a1a7b79)
- Coordinate exact authorized migration barriers with native receipt recovery (2a9c777)
- Coordinate exact persisted mutation starts with partial outcome recovery (8d97a44)
- Define exact prepared replica adoption comparisons without replaying source writes (14046bf)
- Delay shared holon identity and parent publication until acknowledgement (2860061)
- Deliver native-bound automatic replication routes and reconcile changed policy (225eabf)
- Exclude deleted roots from shared provider search results (48cb705)
- feat(cosmic): persist Mongo committed deltas with authoritative acknowledgements (0e05266)
- feat(cosmic): share observed tombstone save admission across providers (42a4cd7)
- feat(cql): bind native graph assembly to read policy and partial ownership (768caa1)
- feat(dynamo): export all validated stored record versions (52254a9)
- feat(ipfs): query retained versions across collections exports and graphs (aea9e68)
- feat(near): persist encrypted history with shared version invariants (40f48d6)
- feat(oracle): serialize protected preparation claims with conditional receipts (eb16e24)
- feat(redis): reuse shared encrypted storage lifecycle with native proof (4e55817)
- feat(search): share public wallet field masks across native and file stores (4bee141)
- feat(storage): export all separately keyed record versions (b35ed98)
- feat(wallet): map native transaction metadata into existing search contracts (35161ac)
- Fence avatar-detail lifecycle writes and history deletion by observed revisions (cc3c4df)
- Fence holon deletion and auxiliary cleanup with native observations (0655f2a)
- Fence paired avatar lifecycle operations with original native observations (2e1ee8e)
- Fence partially acknowledged detail and holon hard deletes (fdec35e)
- Fence partially acknowledged shared avatar hard deletes (62ffbeb)
- Fix canonical Cosmos CQL keys and verify journaled native seed reuse (2ceef12)
- Fix generated Solidity schema initialization with shared compiler-verified emitter (39df56f)
- Fix global Neo route discovery with verified native target ordering (fdf2c92)
